description: §6.7.4 an `<effect>` with no `deps=` never runs (it does not run on mount) — E-EFFECT-NO-DEPS.
rationale: §6.7.4 Syntax: "`deps=` is REQUIRED and SHALL list at least one cell. An `<effect>` with no `deps=`, or with `deps=[]`, never runs (it does not run on mount) and is **E-EFFECT-NO-DEPS**." ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S447 "`when` → outside-world effects only, spelled `<effect>`" — "your recs, except expound 3b, specifically why the engine restriction."
